Problems that may be encountered include bit balling, tight hole conditions and stuck pipe or casing. The oligocene sand in the Vade formation is most likely underpressured, with potential for stuck pipe or losses. However it is unlikely that t

based silicate mud will be used to drill the section. This mud system has proved very efficient in inhibiting the Nordland, Hordaland and Rogaland shales in offset wells. The mud weight will be increased pro-actively ahead of any tight hole signs, as an additional measure of controlling the shales.
